approved_decision.rule: Record word-final -I as a governed distributional tendency associated with action/verb-like, modal or intentional readings in the audited known-meaning corpus. Do not recognize -I as a general morpheme, suffix or productive derivational rule.
approved_decision.rationale: The correlation is strong across known-meaning I-final forms, but only PARAZAMO/PARAZAMI directly isolates a final-vowel contrast within one stem family. The current corpus therefore supports a governed tendency more strongly than a language-wide morpheme.

governance_decisions.decision: Do not license productive or nonproductive X+I derivation from B9.
Do not infer VANI or VANUVALI meanings from final I.
Preserve B8 PARAZAMO/PARAZAMI as the only currently governed family-specific O/I morphological contrast.
Do not create a universal noun/verb or part-of-speech morphology under B9.
B9 changes no lexical authority, grammar, productivity, semantics of individual forms, or curriculum slots.
